subject: Generative trees status: Iris repro, high-cardinality risk
body:
Hi Bruno,

Status. The Iris reproduction is done — run_example.sh end to end, and our generated samples look right (plausible setosa and versicolor rows with sensible sepal/petal ranges). Katya's fidelity battery on Iris shows per-column marginals within 3% of the real data.

Internal tables: the first (5M rows, 40 columns) trains in 6 hours on one CPU host via the Wrapper copycat path; density plots from Generate look convincing for the analyst use case.

Two risks: our CI has no Java toolchain, so builds are manual right now — fixing this week. And on high-cardinality categorical columns (10k+ values) tree splits get shallow and fidelity drops; Katya is quantifying that before we commit to table two.

Jorge
